hook: A new metal catalyst turns tert-butylacetylene into ring-shaped polymers.
summary: Ring-shaped polymers lack chain ends and behave differently from linear ones. A new metallacyclobutadiene catalyst, held by two tethers, makes cyclic poly(tert-butylacetylene), which is not typical for this monomer. Evidence for rings comes indirectly from chromatography and viscosity, and the scope so far is preliminary.
title: A Double-Tethered Metallacyclobutadiene Catalyst for Cyclic Polymer Synthesis
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
